context: EASA CS-25 pressurised cabin, normal operation
quantity_or_criterion: not more than 8000 ft at maximum operating altitude under normal conditions
what_it_does_not_support: a high-speed cabin demonstration or passenger-comfort pass

context: EASA CS-25 pressurised cabin, probable failure
quantity_or_criterion: not more than 15000 ft after a reasonably probable pressurisation failure when certification above 25000 ft is requested
what_it_does_not_support: normal-operation comfort, aircraft-specific feasibility, or operational procedure

quantity_or_criterion: at least 0.25 kg fresh air per minute per occupant; sufficient uncontaminated air and reasonable passenger comfort
what_it_supports: a general ventilation and cabin-air-quality baseline
what_it_does_not_support: a complete thermal, acoustic, pressure, or high-speed environment result

quantity_or_criterion: not less than 0.18 kg/min per person for periods exceeding five minutes, subject to air-quality conditions
what_it_does_not_support: a normal comfort threshold or high-speed serviceability pass

quantity_or_criterion: no perceptible buffeting in cruise; any acceleration proxy must correlate with pilot assessment
what_it_supports: a certification-evidence category for cruise buffeting
what_it_does_not_support: a universal passenger acceleration or high-speed cabin threshold

quantity_or_criterion: 16 g dynamic seat test in survivable emergency-landing context
what_it_does_not_support: normal-flight comfort, ride quality, or high-speed cabin serviceability
